products.name: Sector Misting Concentrate
products.source: Sector label (EPA Reg. No. 1021-1834): "Only use this product in residential misting systems that have been calibrated to apply no more than the maximum application rate of 9.5 fl. oz. of 0.09% synergized permethrin solution per 1,000 cu. ft. per day." "Mix 1/2 gallon (64 fl. oz.) of concentrate in 55 gallons of water to yield a solution of 0.09% ... For high populations of insects or when treating species that are difficult to control, mix up to 1 gallon of concentrate in 55 gallons of water to yield a solution of 0.18% ..."
